name: v1-italian-clinic
status: working snapshot, verified on microphone input

input.aggregation: mean probability over voice-gated 4 s windows

training_data: Italian Parkinson's Voice and Speech only (clinic microphone, 61 speakers)
architecture: 5-fold ensemble of PDNet over a fixed log-mel front end
known_limitations: Trained on one clinic microphone; on English smartphone recordings it flags only 6 of 16 people with Parkinson's.
High specificity, low sensitivity off-domain: a 'not flagged' result on an unfamiliar microphone is weak evidence.
Screening demo only. Not a diagnosis and not a medical device.
